blocks.content: You've built a solid foundation. Now it's time to use it!
The best way to lock in your skills is by applying them in a real project.
Your next step: build a simple, fun game—Rock, Paper, Scissors in C.
It might sound small, but it brings everything together in one focused challenge.
Let's take a closer look at why this project is the perfect next move.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
